Processes genesis, snapshot, and replay input to update tower state and emit vote transactions.

# Purpose
`fd_tower_tile.c` implements the `tower` tile in the transaction processing pipeline. It connects replay, snapshot, and genesis inputs to the vote tower state used by the validator. The file keeps local state for the current epoch, the ghost tree, the validator tower, and the vote accounts received from replay. It also opens the checkpoint and restore files used to save and load tower state across restarts. The tile is built as a `fd_stem` callback target, so it receives fragments from upstream tiles and publishes a `fd_tower_slot_done_t` message after it processes a completed slot.

The main work in the file is to initialize voting state from genesis or snapshot data, then update that state from replay vote-account data. The [`update_ghost`](<#update_ghost>) and [`replay_slot_completed`](<#replay_slot_completed>) functions check replayed vote towers against the ghost tree, compute the next vote slot, update the root when needed, build the vote transaction, and determine the next reset slot. The file also defines the tile setup code for privileged and unprivileged init, seccomp and file-descriptor policy, and the final `fd_tile_tower` tile descriptor that exports the tile into the runtime.
